title: Visit run-sheet row (<unit>/run-sheets/<person>/<visit>.csv, restricted)
description: One row of a generated run sheet, read as an object of strings (e.g. csv.DictReader). The header is exactly the methodology visit-run-sheet-template.csv: participant_id, visit, block, expected_count, actual_count, start_time, end_time, comfort_check, phone_locked, hash_check, deviations, operator_signoff. One row per schedule block, in block order. The generator fills participant_id (person slot ID until the console binds the coded participant ID), visit, block, expected_count and, when a package-hash mapping is given, hash_check; every other column is empty until the operator or console fills it. Rows never hold method labels, roles or intended answers. See docs/interfaces/schedules.md.

participant_id.description: Person slot ID as generated; the console may substitute the coded participant ID bound by the reveal API.

actual_count.description: Operator or console: items actually run.

hash_check.description: Expected package hash as generated (empty without a mapping); the console records the check result in its own log.
